paragraphs: Yitzchak of Kfar Darom. R' Elazar, his son; [Sotah 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.20b.13-14).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbi Elazar son of Yitzchak of Kfar Darom. The child and father have separate entries in Heilprin under [Elazar](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=529&lang=en) and [Yitzchak](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2222&lang=en).
איש כפר דרום means “man of Kfar Darom.” Hyman explicitly calls Elazar his son. The father has no personal title here; the son’s abbreviated title remains R'.
